opening.argument: The creator promotes Azza Miner as a legitimate source of daily Bitcoin-mining income, claiming roughly $11 a day from $750 and projecting $23–$24 a day after adding more. He tells viewers they can start with $100, directs them to a referral link, and demonstrates sending USDC to the platform to buy hashrate. Yet he acknowledges that the money put in cannot be withdrawn. That combination establishes a solicitation for paid mining returns: viewers are encouraged to deposit inaccessible principal on the strength of repeated earnings claims and an endorsement. The personal-test framing and risk disclaimers qualify the presentation, but do not make it chiefly critical reporting.
